title: FairDistillation: Mitigating Stereotyping in Language Models

bias_targets.methodology:
Using template sentences (e.g., ' is a

') to measure differences in model prediction probabilities and associations between gendered pronouns (e.g., 'he', 'she') and attribute words like professions. The bias is quantified using Log Probability Bias Score (LPBS), Discovery of Correlations (DisCo), and Mean Ranking Difference (MRD).
